title: Google Build with AI @ UTRGV
details:
About this event

Calling all developers in the Rio Grande Valley!

Build with AI, a global event series enabling developers to learn and build using Google's latest artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies, is coming to the RGV!

Join us for an exciting day of:
- Hands-on workshops
- Networking opportunities and lunch
- And much more!

Don't miss this chance to:
- Get hands-on experience with Google AI and ML tools
- Learn from industry experts
- Connect with other developers in the RGV tech community
- Get inspired to build innovative solutions with AI

Come with your personal laptops.

#BuildWithAI #UTRGV #VISI
description: A global event series enabling developers to learn and build with Google's latest AI & ML technologies.

title: OSINT Workshop
description:
Hands-on OSINT workshop covering people-finding, infrastructure reconnaissance, and safe analysis workflows.
Speaker: Mauricio Martinez.

title: picoCTF Workshop
description:
Beginner-friendly, hands-on CTF workshop to learn offensive security fundamentals.
Speaker: Damian Villarreal.

title: Vulnerability Management Workshop
description:
Hands-on workshop with live demos: AngryIPScanner, Nmap, and OpenVAS, plus vulnerable machines in the VSOC and mitigation steps.
Speaker: Mauricio Martinez.

title: VISI First General Meeting
description: Kickoff meeting to meet the community, learn what VISI is, and how to get involved. No experience required, just curiosity.

title: Build Your Skills: Agentic AI on AWS, Pt. 1
details:
Whether you’re just starting out or already comfortable with the basics, come explore AWS, Builder Center, and your free student benefits, and start building toward your Agentic AI microcredential.

Build real projects with AWS’s AI tools, learn how to get the most out of Builder Center and your student perks, and meet fellow UTRGV builders.
description: AWS Builder Center x VISI invite you to our hands-on workshop, kicking off the series at UTRGV.

title: Build Your Skills: Agentic AI on AWS, Pt. 2
details:
AWS Builder Center x VISI are back for Part 2 of our hands-on workshop series. This time we’re walking through the full agentic AI workflow, from the code to the finished agent running, so you can see how the pieces fit together.

See how an AI agent actually gets built and deployed on AWS, learn how to use Builder Center and your student perks, and leave with a clear next step toward your Agentic AI microcredential.
description: Watch an AI agent go from code to working app, live.
